verdict.rationale: Qodo docs explicitly state you can 'trigger a Qodo code review manually or automatically, and control when reviews run on a pull request' (qodo-docs-26), and configuration can be set at org/repo level or via a .pr_agent.toml config-as-code file (qodo-docs-10, qodo-docs-11), which implies fine-grained trigger control. However, the pack lacks explicit documentation of skipping draft PRs or filtering triggers by branch/label — the only label-related evidence is about risk classification tags for triage (qodo-docs-8, qodo-docs-25), not review-trigger filtering. Missing for 10: explicit doc/example of draft-PR skip, branch-based trigger rules, and label-based trigger filters.
